in_hebrew.name: כרזל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'khrzl', which means 'shining one' or 'mighty one'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name, often used in Jewish traditions.

in_greek.name: Χρυσίλερ
in_greek.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Greek words 'chrysos' meaning 'gold' and 'leros' meaning 'flowing'. It can be translated as 'golden flow' or 'golden river'.

in_latin.name: Chryslerius
in_latin.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Latin word 'chrysos' meaning 'gold' and the suffix '-arius', which means 'man of'. It can be translated as 'golden man' or 'man of gold'.
